اغتنمن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَمْنَ (iḡtanamna) /iɣ.ta.nam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اُغْتُنِمْنَ (uḡtunimna) /uɣ.tu.nim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اِغْتَنِمْنَ (iḡtanimna) /iɣ.ta.nim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
